title: Iran, 12 other delegations walk out at CICA Summit in Baku over Israeli PM speech
text:
Iran, 12 other delegations walk out at CICA Summit in Baku over Israeli PM speech "
" "
"🔆🔅BAKU, 15 Oct 2026 — The Iranian delegation to the 7th Summit of the Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia (CICA), led by Kazem Gharibabadi, Deputy Foreign Minister for Legal and International Affairs, along with 12 other delegations, walked out of the summit hall on Thursday as the Israeli representative began his speech. "

"The walkout was in protest against the Israeli leader’s address. The delegations of Iran, Palestine, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Iraq, Egypt, Kuwait, Qatar, Jordan, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Bangladesh left the hall. "

"According to the Iranian delegation, 12 of the 28 participating delegations joined the walkout. The move was widely reflected at the summit, with nearly half of the delegations expressing opposition to the Israeli regime. "

"The scene once again highlighted the isolation of the Israeli regime. Footage shows the moment the delegations leave the hall.
